mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_detail (id, match_id, dim_code, dim_name, dim_type, student_content, job_require, score, gap_analysis, improvement_suggestion, match_desc, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{matchId}, #{dimCode}, #{dimName}, #{dimType}, #{studentContent}, #{jobRequire}, #{score}, #{gapAnalysis}, #{improvementSuggestion}, #{matchDesc}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM match_detail WHERE match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY dim_type ASC, dim_code ASC
